newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila reduces treasury bill offer to 5 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila reduces treasury bill offer to 5 bln pesos.

text.p: The Bureau of Treasury announced on Thursday it was reducing its weekly offer of treasury bills to five billion pesos from six billion.

Broken down into maturities, the volume of the 182-day bill was cut down to 1.5 billion pesos from 2.0 billion and the 364-day will be down to 2.0 billion pesos from 2.5 billion pesos. The volume of the 91-day bill will stay at 1.5 billion pesos.
It also said next Tuesday's monthly auction of two-year, fixed rate Treasury notes will be cut to three billion pesos from four billion pesos.
One dealer said: "It seems they want to help the market remain liquid by reducing the volume."
